children: Li Auto launched its next-generation flagship all-electric MPV, the Li Auto Mega Home, with a single configuration priced at RMB 509,800, and deliveries will begin gradually this week, according to ETNet.

The right-hand-drive version is expected to enter Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore in the fourth quarter. The new Mega has been upgraded in three areas: cabin luxury, ride comfort and intelligent driving. It is equipped with four LiDAR processors, dual M100 chips and 2,560 TOPS of computing power. The cabin features a 29-inch OLED 6K panoramic center display, a 21-inch OLED 4K rear movable screen and a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8797 smart cockpit chip. The second row has electrically rotating zero-gravity seats with 18-point hot-stone kneading massage, while the third row supports ventilation and heating.

title: Li Auto Launches Mega Home Flagship Electric MPV At RMB 509,800
